title: PlayerChatColor
description: Let players customize the color of their chat messages with a simple command!
body:
# PlayerChatColor

A lightweight plugin that lets players customize the color of their chat messages!

## Features
- Set your chat color with a simple command
- 14 different colors to choose from
- Reset your color back to normal anytime
- See all available colors with /chatcolor list

## Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/chatcolor <color>` | Set your chat color |
| `/chatcolor reset` | Reset to default color |
| `/chatcolor list` | See all available colors |

## Available Colors
red, blue, green, yellow, aqua, gold, gray, dark_red, dark_blue, dark_green, dark_aqua, dark_gray, light_purple, white

## Compatibility
- Paper 26.1.2+
- Java 25+
